svg.aria-label: Entity relationship diagram of the ten Prisma models: User is the tenant root owning Account, Session, Company, LinkedInConnection, Job, AgentEvent and CandidateProfile; Job owns Application and AgentEvent; CandidateProfile optionally owns Application; VerificationToken stands alone.

svg.text: User is the tenant root: every query in the application is scoped through it. Each edge is labelled with its cardinality and its onDelete behaviour.
